ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a transition-state/reaction schematic structure with curved arrows; after ignoring the arrows, a central carbon can be seen connected to three parts: below is a terminal alkene chain, on the left is a carboxylic acid group C(=O)O, and on the right is a methyl-substituted acyl/acetyl group C(=O)CH3. Then reason: according to the specified method, from the terminal alkene along the allylic chain to the central carbon, then connecting to the carboxylic acid carbon, the main chain is written as C=CCC...C(=O)O. The acetyl group on the right side of the central carbon is written as a branch C(C)=O. Combining the main chain and branch gives the SMILES: C=CCC(C(C)=O)C(=O)O.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First ignore all curved arrows in the transition-state drawing. Convert only the atom-bond framework: choose the main path from the terminal alkene through the allyl chain to the central carbon and then to the carboxylic acid carbon, giving C=CCC...C(=O)O. At the central carbon, add the acetyl branch shown on the right as C(C)=O, i.e. a carbonyl carbon bonded to CH3. Combine the main path and branch as C=CCC(C(C)=O)C(=O)O.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个带有曲箭头的过渡态/反应示意结构；忽略箭头后，可见一个中心碳连接三部分：下方是末端烯烃链，左侧是羧酸基 C(=O)O，右侧是带甲基的酰基/乙酰基 C(=O)CH3。再推理：按指定方法，从末端烯烃沿烯丙基链到中心碳，再接到羧酸碳，主链写作 C=CCC...C(=O)O。中心碳右侧的乙酰基作为支链写作 C(C)=O。将主链和支链组合，得到 SMILES：C=CCC(C(C)=O)C(=O)O。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct heavy-atom graph transcription route: it treats the drawing as a skeletal structure, discards the curved-arrow transition-state annotations, and converts the remaining connectivity into one canonical-enough SMILES. With a target count of one, no alternative route is needed.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the molecular skeleton in the image: a central carbon is bonded to a left carboxylic acid group C(=O)O, a right acetyl carbonyl group C(=O)CH3, and a downward allyl chain CH2-CH=CH2. Also note the curved arrows and proton-transfer markings are annotations to ignore, not extra bonds.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the desired output is a SMILES expression and that the arrows in the transition-state picture must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use organic skeletal-structure conventions: unlabeled vertices are carbons with implicit hydrogens; double lines to O are carbonyls; O-H on the carboxyl group is represented as O in neutral SMILES; curved arrows do not change the atom connectivity when explicitly told to ignore them. Use SMILES branching to encode substituents from a chosen main chain.
